maddeler.e:
ندلهم (form IVq)
# نَدْلَهِمُّ (nadlahimmu) /nad.la.him.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
# نَدْلَهِمَّ (nadlahimma) /nad.la.him.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
# نَدْلَهِمِّ (nadlahimmi) /nad.la.him.mi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
